entities.name: UE requested PDN disconnect procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to disconnect from a PDN.

entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to request PDN disconnection.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to deactivate EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer to be deactivated.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE must be in EMM-REGISTERED state to initiate PDN disconnect.

relations.description: Procedure includes sending PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message.
Procedure includes receiving DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contains EPS bearer identity IE.
Procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
